reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Handwritten over a partly pre-filled sheet. STRUCK-THROUGH VALUES: lines 5 and 7 each carry a machine-printed '$0.00' that has been struck through with a pen, with the filer's hand-written figure written ABOVE it - the SURVIVING (hand-written) values 640.00 and 500.00 are what is recorded here; the struck '$0.00' is not. Same superscript-cents notation as this filer's June report ('640' with a raised '00'); hand-drawn '$' signs dropped per spec. Line 3 is written as a doubled zero with raised cents, transcribed verbatim as '00.00' (i.e. the filer's way of writing zero) at medium confidence. Column B cents on lines 1 and 2 (1,444.16 / 944.16) are small raised, underlined pairs - medium confidence. Nothing was arithmetic-derived.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($640 with raised cents '00') on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Total Contributions Received' (640.00) and its handwritten page subtotal (640.00, written beside a struck machine-printed '$0.00')
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum to 140.00 + 500.00 = 640.00 exactly = the schedule's page subtotal = its Total Contributions Received = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Column A. ⚠ AGAIN THIS CLOSES ONLY WITH THE IN-KIND ROW COUNTED INLINE: the filer marks the 140.00 PoliticalWS.com row '(In-Kind)', and a monetary-only sum is 500.00, which matches nothing printed. Both conventions were tested; monetary-plus-in-kind closes to the cent, consistent with this same filer's earlier 2010 report. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 1,444.16 and is NOT summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (140.00) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's handwritten 'Subtotal for this page' (140.00, beside a struck machine-printed '$0.00') and its handwritten 'Total Expenditures Received' (140.00)
expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row sums to 140.00 = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A. It is the expenditure side of the same in-kind website-hosting transaction that appears as contribution line 1, booked on both sides as the form's arithmetic requires. Column B YTD expenditures print 944.16 and were not summed as an increment. The p2 ladder closes on the HANDWRITTEN values that govern over the struck machine-printed ones: line 3 (00.00) + line 4 (640.00) = line 5 (640.00, written over a struck '$0.00'); 640.00 - line 6 (140.00) = line 7 (500.00, written over a struck '$0.00').

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND — tested both ways. Monetary-only contributions sum to 500.00, which appears nowhere on the filing; counting the filer's own '(In-Kind)'-annotated 140.00 row gives 640.00, which is simultaneously Schedule A's subtotal, its Total Contributions Received and the cover's Column A. The same 140.00 is carried on Schedule B, so the in-kind transaction sits inside BOTH stated totals. This is the second consecutive filing by this filer to behave this way (see 4592dac0), so the convention is the FILER's, not a one-off.
itemized.escalation_note: (1) ROW-INDEX ESCALATION (the off-by-one trap): on Schedule A the second entry does NOT sit on printed row 2. Row 1's payee cell runs onto a continuation line ('(Website Hosting)') that occupies printed row 2, and 900 dpi band crops of the amount column proved it: the [18.05,21.85] band rendered '$140 00 (In-Kind', the [21.85,25.65] band rendered an EMPTY amount cell, and the [25.65,29.45] band rendered '$500 00'. The 500.00 row is therefore recorded as printed row 3. (2) COLUMN OVERRUN: on that same row the filer wrote the figure to the right of the printed amount underline, so the measured amount band (80.69-90.11) clips it; the row carries an explicit widened `geometry` box (pct:80.69,25.65,14.37,3.80@p3) that renders '$500 00' in full, and that box wins over the frame for this row.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Bryan E. Thompson' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row; the page face governs. Office Seeking hand-written 'Utah County Clerk/Auditor'; party 'Republican'; residence city Spanish Fork, UT (the cover prints a street address, deliberately not recorded). legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 COVER ('Seven days preceding the General Election' checked, amendment 'No', signed 10/25/10, clerk stamp OCT 26 AM 8:43), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (its own printed header; filer's page box numbers it '1 of 3' with the cover uncounted), p3 SCHEDULE A ('2 of 3'), p4 SCHEDULE B ('3 of 3'). FORM PROPERTY: this sheet was PARTLY PRE-FILLED BY MACHINE and then corrected by hand — Summary lines 5 and 7 and both schedule subtotals carry a machine-printed '$0.00' that the filer STRUCK THROUGH and overwrote by hand (640.00 / 500.00 / 640.00 / 140.00). Under the standing rule that handwritten corrections over struck typed values govern, the handwritten figures are the ones transcribed, and every struck value is named here rather than silently dropped. Also note the cover is headed simply 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with no year and cites 'Utah County Code 2-5-2' (the filer's earlier 2010 filing cites '2-5'), i.e. a different template vintage — the form header is never used to date a filing. THE SAME-FILER COVER CHAIN HOLDS EXACTLY: this report's line 3 beginning balance (00.00) matches the earlier report's slashed-zero close, and its Column B year-to-date figures reproduce the sum of the two periods to the cent (804.16 + 640.00 = 1,444.16 contributions; 804.16 + 140.00 = 944.16 expenditures). Reported as an OBSERVATION — no figure here was derived by differencing covers, and each filing was transcribed strictly on its own terms.
